items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Bennie, I didn't mention his name. He was the oldest of the family.

ctx.x: Well, next to me is a sister, Florida, her name is Morgan now. And next to her is a brother, Bubba, his name is Isaac, after my dad, and then we have twin brothers, James and Joe, Joe Lutcher, who is pretty well known, was known in the jazz circles at one time. He's gone into another field now, the religious field. And then we had a brother, a young brother to die, in the service, he was a bass player and his name was Charlie. And I think he was about 21 when he died. And we have four -- we had four little…
Bennie, I didn't mention his name. He was the oldest of the family. And Vida was next to the younger girl. She died in 1971.
Did anybody besides you and Joe go into music? Well, Charlie, but --
